name: ESR-REIT
summary: ESR-REIT is a leading New Economy and future-ready Asia Pacific S-REIT. Listed on the Singapore Exchange Securities Trading Limited since 25 July 2006, ESR-REIT invests in quality income producing industrial properties in key gateway markets. As at 30 June 2026, ESR-REIT holds interests in a diversified portfolio of logistics properties, high specifications industrial properties, business parks and general industrial properties with total assets of approximately S5.6 billion dollars.
